_comment: This file exists so that 'Perth' stops being a string literal. It was
the rewrite slug of the specialty taxonomy, the path of the hub, the
fallback in the answer block, the AdministrativeArea in the schema, and
a hard-coded word in roughly twenty files. None of that is wrong for a
one-city directory. All of it is a migration for a two-city one.
`default` is the city assumed when nothing else identifies one. Exactly
one city may hold it. It is what keeps every existing Perth URL working
byte-for-byte while the code underneath stops being about Perth.
Adding a city is a change to this file plus its area terms and its
listings. It should never again be a change to the code.
`region` is the schema.org AdministrativeArea. `centre` is used for
distance and map defaults, not for anything a page asserts.

cities.name: Perth
read_up: Perth spreads out. Three hundred and seventy-seven practices sit across a hundred and twenty-two suburbs, and the distribution is lopsided in a way that matters the moment you start deciding where to go: the CBD holds fifty-five of them, Fremantle twenty-one, Subiaco twelve, and everywhere from Joondalup to Mandurah shares what is left over.

Perth Central on its own carries more listings than the northern suburbs, the western suburbs and the hills put together. That shape has a practical consequence for anyone choosing. If you work in the city you can walk to a good deal of this. If you don't, the drive decides things before the practice does, and a forty-minute each way is the difference between a habit and a one-off. That is why suburb sits ahead of style in the filters, and why the map is the first thing on the page rather than an afterthought at the bottom of it.

Sixty-three of the three hundred and seventy-seven publish a starting price. That isn't many. The median among those is seventy dollars and the range runs from eight to well past a thousand, which tells you how much ground the word "session" is covering here. A drop-in community class and a full day at a destination spa both sit inside that number, and they are not the same purchase. Where a practice hasn't published one, the field is empty rather than filled with a guess.
Sixty-five offer something online or hybrid. That is worth knowing when the drive is the problem rather than the price.

Seven listings have been claimed by the people who run them. The rest we wrote from public information, and every one of those says so on its own page. Some of them will be out of date, because opening hours change faster than we can check them, and we would rather tell you that than let the page look more official than it is.

cities.name: Margaret River
read_up: Seventeen places, across nine towns between Busselton and the Margaret River rivermouth. The region went up here because people drive down from Perth for a weekend and want to know what is open when they arrive. It has roughly doubled since, and is still a long way from a complete picture of what the south west holds.

Heat and cold came first and still weigh the most. Two of the saunas are mobile: one wood-fired and moving around the region, the other parked at the Rivermouth carpark at Prevelly, where the cold half of the contrast is the Indian Ocean rather than a tub you climb into. Neither keeps fixed hours. Both post a schedule instead, so the sensible order is to check where they are before you plan the drive.

The day spas are the other half of that. BODHI at Yallingup and Yala at Naturaliste are built around a half day rather than an hour, and MEND is on Bussell Highway in Margaret River itself, which makes it the one you can walk to from town.

What has been added since is the ordinary weekly kind. Five yoga studios now, from a beachside room at Gnarabup to Ashtanga in town and Kundalini out at Yallingup, and one teacher who drives to houses around Dunsborough and Eagle Bay rather than keeping a room at all. Massage, osteopathy, physiotherapy and a naturopath fill in the rest — the things you book when you live here rather than when you are down for three days.

Not one of the seventeen publishes a price. That is the gap. Several list figures on their own sites without saying plainly what the number buys, so the field is empty rather than guessed. None have been claimed by their owners yet either, which means every word here came from the business's own website.
